clarifications.deduplication_order: Generate all candidates in canonical rho-index, phi-index, psi-index order; quotient by dense 5x5 trace distance before applying any packing order.
clarifications.trace_distance: Use eigvalsh of the explicitly Hermitian 5x5 density difference. Reject values outside [-1e-12,1+1e-12] and clip only boundary roundoff.
clarifications.greedy_boundary: Accept a candidate only when every dense trace distance is at least epsilon+1e-12.
clarifications.hash_order: SHA256 of ASCII 'seed:rho_index:phi_index:psi_index', with the canonical index triple as tie breaker.
clarifications.small_exact_grid: Use rho indices for values {0,1} and main 8-angle-grid phi/psi indices {0,1}, hence angles {0,pi/4}.
clarifications.finite_difference: Use a five-point central stencil with h=1e-5 and compare scale-normalised metric error.
clarifications.projective_quotient: Report both V(R)=2*pi^2*sinh(R)^2 and the M~-M quotient volume pi^2*sinh(R)^2; both have exponent 2.

pgm.success_operator: G=(1/N)*sum_i |v_i><v_i| on the four-dimensional success block.
pgm.outcomes: N message outcomes plus one explicit common erasure outcome with P(erasure|i)=1-p_i.
guards: sum_j E_j agrees with the support projector within 1e-10
raw row-sum error is at most 1e-10
clip only values in [-1e-12,0] before final row normalisation

audit_disclosure.note: The section reported in-memory finite-grid diagnostics after the parent hash was frozen. Those diagnostics did not change any parent hypothesis or threshold and cannot be promoted to independent evidence.
